pages.title: Network Map
pages.text: Junctions and links, woven so that every place is joined to every other and none hangs by a single thread. Made on the Graph Loom. It routes Photonic Processors, and the living networks of a cell are read with it.
Made in $(item)Mycelium Bed$() and $(item)Pattern Basin$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Networks.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Photonic Processor.
